boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-East Bay
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops in Hayward with directly verified late operating hours.

cards.title: Tailfeather Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 926 B St, Hayward
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s posted hours to time a downtown pickup or meal, and confirm service details directly before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A B Street restaurant whose official site lists service through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Tailfeather Kitchen’s official site lists its Hayward address at 926 B St and business hours ending at 12:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Tailfeather Kitchen
cards.access_notes: Official site lists business hours through 12:00 a.m.; check the page for the applicable day before visiting.

cards.title: Denny's on Industrial Parkway
cards.subtitle: 30163 Industrial Parkway Southwest, Hayward
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, pickup, or delivery as offered, and use the location page to reconfirm its all-day listing before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Hayward Denny’s location with posted near-24-hour daily service.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official location page lists this Hayward restaurant’s hours as 12:00 a.m.–11:58 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Denny's — 30163 Industrial Parkway Southwest
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 12:00 a.m.–11:58 p.m. and offers dine-in, pickup, and delivery.

cards.title: McDonald's on West A Street
cards.subtitle: 355 W A St, Hayward
cards.notes: For a late drive-through order, check the official location page and use its listed drive-through schedule rather than lobby hours.
cards.short_summary: A West A Street stop with later drive-through hours than its lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s lists drive-through service at 355 W A St until 12:30 a.m. most nights and 2:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 355 W A St, Hayward
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-through hours to 12:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; lobby closes earlier.

cards.title: Carl's Jr. on Mission Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 20550 Mission Blvd, Hayward
cards.notes: Use the official location listing to plan a drive-through stop, especially when visiting on the later Thursday through Saturday schedule.
cards.short_summary: Mission Boulevard fast food with midnight and 1 a.m. posted closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl’s Jr. lists this Hayward location open until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 1:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Carl's Jr. — 20550 Mission Blvd, Hayward
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 12:00 a.m. closings Sunday–Wednesday and 1:00 a.m. closings Thursday–Saturday; drive-through is listed.

cards.title: Express Pizza
cards.subtitle: 505 A St #B, Hayward
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s current online schedule, then select carryout or delivery for an A Street option near Hayward Station.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza shop whose own site posts late carryout and delivery hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Express Pizza lists Friday and Saturday business, carryout, and delivery hours until midnight at 505 A Street #B.
cards.source_title: Express Pizza Hayward
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday business, carryout, and delivery hours of 11:00 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Wendy's on Mission Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 23969 Mission Blvd, Hayward
cards.notes: Confirm the posted location hours before going, then use the restaurant or drive-through service listed on Wendy’s official page.
cards.short_summary: A Mission Boulevard restaurant with a uniform 1 a.m. schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-through hours of 6:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. daily at 23969 Mission Blvd.
cards.source_title: Wendy's — 23969 Mission Blvd, Hayward
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists both restaurant and drive-through service until 1:00 a.m. every day.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 25198 Hesperian Blvd
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Hesperian Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 25198 Hesperian Blvd, Hayward
cards.notes: Use the drive-through schedule for a late stop; the official page distinguishes it from the earlier-closing lobby schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Hesperian Boulevard drive-through with posted service until 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists drive-through hours of 4:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. daily at 25198 Hesperian Blvd; its lobby closes at 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 25198 Hesperian Blvd, Hayward
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-through hours continuously to 4:00 a.m.; lobby hours are 6:30 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger on Harder Avenue
cards.subtitle: 709 Harder Ave, Hayward
cards.notes: Use the official location page to verify the day’s closing time, then choose the listed drive-through or dine-in seating option.
cards.short_summary: A Harder Avenue burger stop with late-night hours posted by the company.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out’s official Hayward page lists 709 Harder Ave and shows service until 1:00 a.m. on the displayed daily schedule.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — 709 Harder Ave, Hayward
cards.access_notes: Official location page identifies drive-through and dine-in seating and displays a 1:00 a.m. closing time; reconfirm the day’s schedule.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Jackson Street
cards.subtitle: 215 W Jackson St, Hayward
cards.notes: Plan for the drive-through when arriving late, because the official page lists a later drive-through schedule than dine-in service.
cards.short_summary: A West Jackson Street drive-through listed until 4 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-through hours of 7:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. every day at 215 W Jackson Street in Hayward.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 215 W Jackson St, Hayward
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-through hours until 4:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours may differ, so check before visiting.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Mission Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 22859 Mission Blvd, Hayward
cards.notes: Use the location page to choose delivery or carryout, with extra attention to the later Friday and Saturday listed closing times.
cards.short_summary: A Mission Boulevard pizza location with service listed through midnight or 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists restaurant hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 22859 Mission Blvd.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 22859 Mission Blvd, Hayward
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists delivery and carryout hours to midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Hayward-campus places for studying, connecting, playing, and using campus resources.

cards.title: CORE Library
cards.subtitle: Hayward campus
cards.notes: Start here when you need books, loanable technology, study rooms, or a change of pace between classes; bring your Bay Card for library equipment.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines collections, technology lending, study areas, and student-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB says the CORE building offers books, technology rentals, study rooms, presentation-practice rooms, a meditation room, and a family playroom.
cards.source_title: The CORE Building Shows How East Bay LEED’s the Way in Campus Sustainability
cards.access_notes: Check current library access and room-reservation rules before visiting.

cards.title: The CORE’s quiet second floor
cards.subtitle: CORE Library, Hayward campus
cards.notes: Use the quiet floor for solo reading or concentrated laptop work; the university describes seating with personal outlets and storage for your things.
cards.short_summary: A designated quieter library floor with individual-style seating and power access.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB identifies the CORE’s second floor as a quiet floor with seating, personal outlets, and storage space.
cards.source_title: The CORE Building Shows How East Bay LEED’s the Way in Campus Sustainability
cards.access_notes: Respect the quiet-floor setting and any posted library policies.

cards.title: Student Center for Academic Achievement
cards.subtitle: CORE Building, Room 343
cards.notes: Bring a course question, draft, or assignment prompt to connect with tutoring, writing support, supplemental instruction, or academic coaching.
cards.short_summary: An academic-support center for course help, writing, study strategies, and student success resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The SCAA lists tutoring, writing assistance, supplemental instruction, and academic coaching, and is located in CORE Building Room 343.
cards.source_title: Student Center for Academic Achievement
cards.access_notes: Located on the CORE Building’s third floor; consult SCAA for service availability.

cards.title: University Union
cards.subtitle: 25800 Carlos Bee Blvd., Hayward campus
cards.notes: Use the Union as a practical meeting point before a program or between classes, then check its posted rooms, services, and current operations.
cards.short_summary: A campus gathering place for meals, programs, services, meetings, and informal interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB describes the University Union as a gathering place where campus community members meet for meals, programs, services, and informal interaction.
cards.source_title: University Union
cards.access_notes: Services and room availability vary; consult the Union’s current hours and location information.

cards.title: GameZone
cards.subtitle: University Union, Hayward campus
cards.notes: Plan a low-key game break or look for a tournament or special event; ask staff about current game-room equipment and participation rules.
cards.short_summary: A University Union game area with staff-supported equipment and events.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB’s GameZone position description identifies a Game Room and Game Cave, equipment checkout, tournaments, and special events.
cards.source_title: GameZone Agent Position Description
cards.access_notes: Confirm current GameZone hours, equipment availability, and facility policies before going.

cards.entity_name: C. E. Smith Museum of Anthropology
cards.title: C. E. Smith Museum of Anthropology
cards.subtitle: Meiklejohn Hall, Room 4047
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition calendar, then build in a short gallery stop before or after class; the museum also lists virtual-programming options.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus anthropology museum with rotating exhibitions and public gallery access.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that its galleries are in Meiklejohn Hall Room 4047 and that admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Current Exhibits — C. E. Smith Museum of Anthropology
cards.access_notes: The museum page lists exhibition dates and gallery closures; verify the current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: WellNest Food Pantry
cards.subtitle: North University Union, first floor
cards.notes: If you need groceries, make an appointment through Bay Advisor, check in at the WellNest front desk, and bring your student ID to shop.
cards.short_summary: A campus food pantry with an appointment-based shopping process for students.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB directs Hayward students to check in at WellNest in the North University Union first floor and shop after an appointment and student-ID check-in.
cards.source_title: Food Pantry
cards.access_notes: Hayward service is appointment-based; follow the current Bay Advisor scheduling instructions.

cards.title: Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Hayward campus
cards.notes: Use the recreation facility for an active study break or wellness routine, and review current facility access details before arriving with a guest.
cards.short_summary: The campus recreation and wellness facility is a map-listed Hayward destination.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB’s current campus stop map identifies the Recreation and Wellness Center (RAW) on the Hayward campus.
cards.source_title: AC Transit Campus Stops Map — August 2025
cards.access_notes: Review Recreation and Wellness Center access requirements and current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Diversity and Inclusion Student Center
cards.subtitle: Hayward campus
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate the center, then check its current programming or services before planning a visit with classmates or student groups.
cards.short_summary: A named student center on the Hayward campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB’s campus stop map identifies the Diversity and Inclusion Student Center as a Hayward-campus destination.
cards.source_title: AC Transit Campus Stops Map — August 2025
cards.access_notes: Check the center’s current programming and access details before visiting.

cards.title: University Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Hayward campus
cards.notes: Look up the gallery’s current exhibition and opening information, then pair a visit with time in nearby academic buildings or the campus transit stop.
cards.short_summary: A named University Art Gallery destination on the Hayward campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB’s current campus stop map identifies the University Art Gallery on the Hayward campus.
cards.source_title: AC Transit Campus Stops Map — August 2025
cards.access_notes: Verify current gallery exhibitions and public hours before visiting.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten recurring Cal State East Bay programs that mark the academic year, welcome Pioneers, and recognize campus participation.

cards.title: Weeks of Welcome
cards.subtitle: Semester-opening campus kickoff
cards.notes: Use the event listings during the first weeks of a semester to choose a welcome program that fits your schedule and transition needs.
cards.short_summary: The official opening series for new and returning students.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay identifies Weeks of Welcome as its official kickoff of events and programs during the first weeks of each semester.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Check the current Weeks of Welcome event listings for dates, locations, and access details.

cards.title: Ask Me Tabling
cards.subtitle: Start-of-semester student-leader help tables
cards.notes: Stop at a staffed table when finding classes or campus services; bring a specific question and use the conversation to get oriented.
cards.short_summary: Student leaders field practical campus questions at key locations.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay says Ask Me Tabling lets students ask student leaders for directions and campus questions at key campus spots.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: The university lists Ask Me Tabling for August 18–25, excluding Fridays; verify current semester details before visiting.

cards.title: Pioneer Palooza
cards.subtitle: Annual club and organization expo
cards.notes: Walk the expo with a short list of interests, then ask participating organizations how to attend a first meeting or volunteer shift.
cards.short_summary: A named annual introduction to recognized student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay describes Pioneer Palooza, formerly East Bay Round, as its annual club and organization expo.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Listed at the University Union/Meiklejohn Walkway during the first two weeks of the semester; confirm current dates.

cards.title: al Fresco
cards.subtitle: Annual fall welcome festival
cards.notes: Arrive early at the Music Building Lawn, browse resource tables, and stay for the scheduled performances if they match your plans.
cards.short_summary: A fall welcome festival pairing campus resources with performances.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay calls al Fresco its annual fall welcome festival and lists campus and community resource tables, performances, and a DJ.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: The page lists the Music Building Lawn and an August date; food is described as available until gone. Verify current details.

cards.title: FalCon: Fall Leadership Conference
cards.subtitle: Fall student leadership gathering
cards.notes: Register or review the program when announced, then select workshops that build a practical skill you can use in a club or class.
cards.short_summary: A named fall conference for emerging student leaders.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay says FalCon offers workshops and collaborative activities for emerging leaders to build skills and connections.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: The signature-events page lists a South University Union MPR location; confirm the current program and participation requirements.

cards.title: Pioneer Leadership Certificate
cards.subtitle: Eight-module student leadership program
cards.notes: Complete the online modules across the semester and save your reflections so you can apply the certificate work to future leadership roles.
cards.short_summary: A semester-long Pioneer-branded leadership recognition practice.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay describes the Pioneer Leadership Certificate as an online eight-module program, with certificates awarded at semester end.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Available to students through the university’s leadership programming; check the current page for enrollment instructions.

cards.title: National Transfer Student Week
cards.subtitle: Third week of October
cards.notes: Look for the week’s campus programming and use it to connect with transfer-oriented resources, advocates, and fellow transfer students.
cards.short_summary: An annual October recognition of transfer students and advocates.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay states that National Transfer Student Week occurs in the third week of October each year and celebrates transfer students and advocates.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Check the signature-events calendar in October for current activities and locations.

cards.title: Make a Difference Day
cards.subtitle: Annual October service day
cards.notes: Choose a listed service project, follow organizer instructions, and plan transportation and attire based on the assigned community activity.
cards.short_summary: A yearly service-oriented campus participation day.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay says Make a Difference Day joins organizations in service each year and identifies the fourth Saturday in October.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: The university lists the fourth Saturday in October; review the current project information before participating.

cards.title: Leadership Banquet and SOLAR Awards
cards.subtitle: Recognition for campus student leadership
cards.notes: If your organization has completed a strong project, review award criteria early and keep a record of its service and event work.
cards.short_summary: A campus recognition gathering tied to SOLAR awards.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay says its Leadership Banquet recognizes student leaders across campus through SOLAR awards for leaders, organizations, advisors, and departments.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Check current nomination, attendance, and location information with Student Leadership and Involvement.

cards.title: Cultural Graduation Celebrations
cards.subtitle: Graduation ceremonies alongside commencement
cards.notes: Review the current celebration options, registration rules, and any fees early; participating graduates may attend more than one ceremony.
cards.short_summary: Student, faculty, and staff partnerships mark graduating students’ identities and journeys.
cards.evidence_claim: CSU East Bay says Cultural Graduation Celebrations are held alongside official commencement and are facilitated through partnerships with students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Cultural + Academic Graduation Celebrations | Cal State East Bay
cards.access_notes: Participation is voluntary and open to graduating students; registration and fees vary by celebration, so consult the current commencement page.
